question: Should modular dashboard workspace tabs get a dashboard-specific path-segment URL contract, and should the generic `/plugin?plugin=...&id=...` route remain the compatibility path for other plugin tabs?
rationale: This changes user-visible Control UI routing and depends on an unmerged dashboard product stack, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent URL contract or compatibility behavior.

options.title: Route with the dashboard stack
options.body: Add the dashboard path-segment route in the Workspaces PR or a follow-up after maintainers accept the dashboard stack, while preserving the generic plugin-tab route for existing tabs.

options.title: Keep query routing for now
options.body: Leave Workspaces on `?ws=` until the dashboard architecture is accepted and route compatibility is better understood.

options.title: Defer to roadmap
options.body: Keep this only as a roadmap item if maintainers are not ready to sponsor bundled dashboard routing work.

recommendation.title: Route with the dashboard stack
recommendation.body: Add the dashboard path-segment route in the Workspaces PR or a follow-up after maintainers accept the dashboard stack, while preserving the generic plugin-tab route for existing tabs.

likelyOwner.reason: The current plugin-tab route and bundled tab seam are tied to his current-main history, making him the best available owner for the route contract decision.
